Read a little-endian unsigned integer out of a raw vector

Source: R/nar_zip.R
nar_le.Rd

`readBin()` reads four bytes as a *signed* integer, so any value past 2^31 comes back negative – offsets into a 1.7 GB archive are already close to that, and a growing NAR will cross it. Accumulating into a double keeps every field exact well past 4 GB.

Usage

nar_le(bytes, at, n)

Arguments

bytes

A raw vector

at

Zero-based offset of the field

n

Field width in bytes

Value

A numeric scalar
